finding: Slovak turnover improved but remained negative, lagging the euro area
bullets: A net 12.83% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported declining turnover in wave 39, improving 13.39 pp from wave 38, yet still contrasting with the EA's net 8.11% increase — suggesting weaker demand.
A net 34.38% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported falling profits, improving 5.42 pp from wave 38, while the EA's net decline stood at 15.39% — a gap of around 19 pp — limiting investment capacity.
Labour cost pressures remained elevated, with a net 78.81% of Slovak firms (n=242) reporting increases — 19.85 pp above the EA net — squeezing margins further.
chart_subtitle: Slovak turnover net balance rose to −12.83% in wave 39.
